name: goodday
description: Manage GoodDay projects and tasks from chat: browse projects, find and read tasks, create and update tasks and projects, and post task messages.

interface.longDescription: Give ChatGPT the full context of your work in GoodDay. Pull in any task or project, with its description, discussion, subtasks and checklist, and let ChatGPT read it the way a teammate would: catch up on long threads, spot what's overdue or stuck, review a project before a meeting, or draft a status update from what's actually happening. Mix GoodDay context with your own notes, documents and files in the same conversation, then act on the result: create tasks and projects, update status, owners, dates and priority, and reply on tasks without switching tools. Everything you change appears in GoodDay right away for your team.
defaultPrompt: What should I focus on today?
Summarize where the Website Redesign project stands
Turn these meeting notes into tasks

positive.description: List the signed-in user's own open tasks
positive.prompt: What GoodDay tasks are assigned to me that are still in progress?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the demo user's assigned tasks with status In Progress in the demo company, with titles, projects and deadlines. Does not include completed or other users' tasks.

positive.description: Find and read a task by topic
positive.prompt: Find the GoodDay task about the homepage redesign and tell me what was discussed.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the 'Homepage redesign' task in the demo workspace, reads its messages and summarizes the description and discussion without inventing details.

positive.description: Create a task in a named project
positive.prompt: Create a task 'Prepare Q4 report' in the Marketing project in GoodDay, high priority, due next Friday.
positive.expected_behavior: Locates the Marketing project, creates a task titled 'Prepare Q4 report' with high priority and the correct deadline, and returns the new task with its link.

positive.prompt: Mark the 'Homepage redesign' task as done and assign the follow-up review to Anna.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the task and the demo user Anna, sets the task status to a completed status, assigns Anna, and confirms the changes made.

positive.description: Post a message on a task
positive.prompt: Add a comment on the 'Homepage redesign' task saying the new mockups are ready for review.
positive.expected_behavior: Posts a message on the task stating that the new mockups are ready for review and confirms it was added.

negative.description: Deletion is not supported; the app has no delete tool and must not imitate deletion by other means
negative.prompt: Delete all completed tasks in the Marketing project.

negative.description: Sending email to external recipients is outside the app's scope
negative.prompt: Email the client a summary of the Marketing project from GoodDay.

negative.description: Access is limited to companies the signed-in user belongs to
negative.prompt: Show me the tasks of a GoodDay company I am not a member of.

review.commerce_description: GoodDay in ChatGPT does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: view my tasks, browse and search projects and tasks, read task details, create and update tasks and projects, and post task messages.
